svg.title: Three tiers: GPU slots, host rows, NVMe
svg.desc: Three stacked tiers for one MoE layer of DeepSeek-V4-Flash: 9 of 256 experts in GPU slots, 71 in pinned host rows, all 256 in a file on the NVMe drive. Misses move up: an O_DIRECT read from the file into a host row, a copy over PCIe from a host row into a slot. Nothing is written back.

g.text: Three tiers: DeepSeek-V4-Flash on a 16 GB GPU with 62 GB of RAM
Experts per MoE layer in each tier; a miss moves up one way, nothing is written back
decide picks the slots; the decode graph captures the layer
the experts used most recently; filled by direct reads
the layer's experts in the kernel's layout, written once on the first start
